# Sortiq Solutions Pvt. Ltd.

> Leading Web Design, Web Development, Mobile Apps & Digital Marketing Agency based in Mohali, Punjab, India.

## About Us
Sortiq Solutions Pvt. Ltd. is an ISO-certified IT solutions and digital transformation company and certified Wix Partner. We craft cutting-edge web applications, bespoke eCommerce platforms, native and cross-platform mobile apps, and data-driven digital marketing strategies for startups, SMEs, and global enterprises.

- **Website**: https://sortiqsolutions.com
- **Headquarters**: E-51, Second Floor, Phase - 8, Industrial Area, S.A.S. Nagar, Mohali, Punjab, India - 160071
- **Phone**: +91 78144 04047
- **Email**: info@sortiqsolutions.com
- **Careers**: careers@sortiqsolutions.com

## Core Services
- **Web Development**: Full-stack solutions using Laravel, PHP, React.js, Next.js, Node.js, MERN stack, Python, and WordPress.
- **Mobile App Development**: Native iOS, Android, Flutter, and React Native mobile applications.
- **Website Designing**: Modern UI/UX design, Figma prototyping, responsive web design, and branding.
- **Wix & CMS Solutions**: Certified Wix Partner, Wix Studio development, Shopify, and custom CMS platforms.
- **Digital Marketing**: Search Engine Optimization (SEO), Pay-Per-Click (PPC), Social Media Marketing (SMM), and content strategy.
- **Generative AI & Emerging Tech**: AI integration, chatbot automation, and workflow modernization.
